intensity.title: Choose the pixel value
intensity.description: A direct drawing instruction returns a five-level whiteness score.

membership.title: Predict shape membership
membership.description: A Noul question asks whether the pixel center belongs to the shape. Probability is shown as intensity; the mask thresholds at0.5.

formula.title: Use a geometric rule
formula.description: The same shape described with an explicit formula. Code can solve these cases exactly; this is a framing control.

scanline.title: Continue the drawing
scanline.description: Draw one row at a time while seeing your previous rows. Same task, with sequential model context.

result.protocol: One frozen pass per case/method. Direct Score and membership Noul share the same task and coordinates. Formula provides additional information. Scanline sees its earlier predicted rows. Exact geometry is a code-solvable control; creative icons have no objective reference.

value.title: A white disk
value.description: Draw a filled white disk centered at(0,0), radius0.62, on black.

value.title: A thin ring
value.description: Draw a white circular ring centered at(0,0), inner radius0.45 and outer radius0.70, on black. Keep the center black.

value.title: A crescent
value.description: Start with a filled disk centered at(0,0), radius0.70. Remove the disk centered at(0.32,0.12), radius0.60. The remaining crescent is white.

value.title: A diagonal band
value.description: Draw a white diagonal band along y=x. A point is white when its y value differs from x by at most0.16. All other points are black.

value.title: Two overlapping disks
value.description: Draw the union of two filled white disks, radius0.43, centered at(-0.32,0) and(0.32,0). The overlap is also white.

value.title: A square with a window
value.description: Draw a filled white square spanning x and y from-0.70 to0.70. Remove a centered square hole spanning x and y from-0.25 to0.25.

value.title: A sitting cat
value.description: Draw a recognizable front-facing sitting cat silhouette, white on black. Include two pointed ears, a rounded head, body, and a curved tail. Center the complete animal with a margin.

value.title: A small sailboat
value.description: Draw a recognizable white sailboat icon on black. Show a boat hull, one vertical mast, and a triangular sail. Leave a margin around the whole object.

value.title: A growing sprout
value.description: Draw a white sprout silhouette on black: a thin vertical stem and two broad leaves reaching left and right. Keep the complete sprout centered with a margin.
